articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.snippet: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.

articles.title: UK Moves Closer to Keeping $5B Bitcoin Haul After High Court Ruling
articles.snippet: A judge ruled that Chinese law should govern fraud victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC seized from Zhimin Qian, in a blow to the claimants.

articles.title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
articles.snippet: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.
